delta: The co-op booked Ilan Vance's descent as an indemnity dive and soaked him four hours instead of
  six. The rig loop refused his lungs and he declined it, going down on the hard line instead, with Quiej
  writing down the hour of each refusal. He crossed the eleven metres by count, found the read-key seating
  two fingers off the co-op's drawing, and seated it. Coming back he was folding through the throat when
  the cycle came, and the door closed on his left hand; the one release is on the vault side, behind him.
  He signed the indemnity on the deck of the lock with the hand he had left, and never said yes aloud.
